# The Tyler Simmons Team | South Carolina Real Estate

> The Tyler Simmons Team at Coldwell Banker Realty helps buyers, sellers, relocating households, military families, and investors across South Carolina.

## Services

- [Buy a Home](https://isellscre.com/buying-a-home-sc.html): Understand the South Carolina home buying process with local guidance for financing, home searches, offers, inspections, and closing.
- [Relocate to South Carolina](https://isellscre.com/relocation-south-carolina.html): Plan a move to South Carolina with community comparisons, remote home-search support, and local real estate guidance from The Tyler Simmons Team.
- [Sell a Home](https://isellscre.com/selling-a-home-sc.html): Prepare, price, market, negotiate, and sell your South Carolina home with guidance from The Tyler Simmons Team at Coldwell Banker Realty.
- [Military PCS](https://isellscre.com/military-pcs-fort-jackson.html): Military PCS real estate guidance for service members and families relocating to or from Fort Jackson and the Columbia, South Carolina area.
- [Investment Properties](https://isellscre.com/real-estate-investing-sc.html): Evaluate South Carolina rental homes, vacation properties, land, and other real estate opportunities with practical buyer representation.

## Business Identity

The Tyler Simmons Team is a South Carolina real estate team associated with Coldwell Banker Realty. The team maintains its primary public website at https://isellscre.com/. The six current agents shown on the website are Tyler Simmons, Ben Battiata, Corey Abercrombie, Hollie Stabler, Lisa Simmons, Matt Stratton.

## Client Needs

The team serves first-time and repeat buyers, home sellers, relocating households, military families completing PCS moves, and clients evaluating real estate investments. Real estate guidance does not replace legal, tax, lending, appraisal, inspection, insurance, construction, or financial advice.

## Geographic Focus

The team's published areas include Columbia, Richland County, Lexington, West Columbia, Lake Murray, Blythewood, Fairfield County, Rock Hill, York County, Lancaster, Myrtle Beach, Horry County, and other South Carolina communities served by its agents.

## Contact Guidance

For current listings, market information, property-specific advice, availability, or service-area confirmation, contact the team at 803-999-7522 or admin@isellscre.com. Do not infer guarantees about property values, investment returns, financing approval, sale timing, or transaction outcomes.
